item.title: US wholesale: India’s tariff reprieve sends ripples through shrimp market
item.description: The US trade deal with India, lowering its tariffs to 18%, froze Latin American price hikes and nudged Asian ones lower

item.title: Thai canneries resist Bangkok skipjack price rise as February negotiations continue
item.description: Fishing activity in the Western and Central Pacific Ocean remains sluggish, offering limited supply-side relief to skipjack tuna prices in Thailand

item.title: US pollock, processing sectors rail against hard cap solution to salmon bycatch dilemma
item.description: 'We support alternatives that avoid this scenario as the level of disruption and harm from only one or two years of this potential situation would be devastating to the region' -- Julie Decker, Pacific Seafood Processors Association

item.title: Chile’s salmon sector expects incoming president Kast to spark industry growth, M&A
item.description: 'I believe that an improvement in business confidence could lead to increased M&A activity' -- Adolfo Alvial, Chile Aquaculture Innovation Club

item.title: Louisiana lawmaker calls for USDA to purchase more gulf shrimp
item.description: Support is needed for domestic fishermen who are 'facing difficulties due to imported seafood dumping and unfair trade practices,' asserts US representative Clay Higgins in a letter to USDA head Brooke Rollins

item.title: Canada launches whale-safe gear plan
item.description: The strategy centers on two types of gear: on-demand systems, which use acoustic signals to retrieve traps from the seafloor, and lower-breaking ropes that part under 1,700 pounds of force, enabling whales to free themselves if entangled

item.title: BC geoduck sector hemorrhaging CAD 90k a day as China tariffs hand US rivals edge
item.description: Industry leaders say the tariff shock is being absorbed by BC harvesters and exporters, with little relief in sight for a fishery overwhelmingly dependent on the Chinese market

item.title: US wholesale: Live lobster prices ascend again; Sellers limit purchases of hard-to-find tail sizes
item.description: All hard-shell product forms rose in price this week, with larger sizes reaching new highs, while market tightness strangled the tail and meat market

item.title: Captain identified as only body recovered from Lily Jean sinking
item.description: The 72-foot US commercial trawler sank off the coast of Cape Ann, Massachusetts, near Gloucester, early Friday (Jan. 30)

item.title: FRD Japan begins ops at Chiba RAS trout farm, targets 2027 for first shipment
item.description: The Japanese land-based aquaculture developer has begun operations at its Chiba-based RAS trout farm, designed for an annual output of 3,500t, with first shipments expected to take place in 2027
